minutes.headline: Planning Board approved an ANR on Sunny Hill Road and a de minimis change at Lunenburg Central; solar bylaw talk set for Jan 23.
minutes.summary: The Planning Board heard a resident's concerns about solar development on natural lands and agreed to put a solar bylaw discussion on a January agenda. It approved an ANR for 255 Sunny Hill Road and a de minimis change for the Lunenburg Central project, reviewed two stormwater decisions awaiting signature, approved minutes, took committee reports, and adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved an ANR for 255 Sunny Hill Road on a roll call vote; the count of ayes was not stated.
The board accepted a request as a de minimis change for the Lunenburg Central project at 475 Leominster Shirley Road, on a roll call vote.
After a resident raised solar development on natural land, the board placed a solar bylaw discussion on the January 23 agenda for 30 to 45 minutes.
Two stormwater decisions, for Reservoir Road and Highland, need no vote and will be signed by the chair and members.
The zoning board's peer review consultant for Pond View Commons had not yet received funds, so no work had started.

why_it_matters: The solar bylaw discussion is the first step toward a possible change to where solar can be built, and any bylaw change would later go to residents for a town meeting vote.
The Pond View Commons engineering review is paid for by a funding step that had not happened yet, so the review of that housing proposal had not started.
